content.short: Web3 Scaffold is a fullstack framework for deploying applications to EVM networks.
content.description: Web3 Scaffold is a monorepo that bundles a variety of packages to help developers rapidly deploy smart contracts and applications on Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible blockchains. Each package emphasizes accessibility and shares a common TypeScript foundation. The suite includes a front end built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, Solidity smart contracts, and a read-only backend designed for deployment to a data indexing service. Together, these components enable end-to-end development workflows from a single repository.
